lenses.name: Drinking-water price
lenses.description: Population-weighted SISPEA 2024 drinking-water service price for a reference consumption of 120 m³ per year, including taxes and water-agency fees. Multi-commune service territories are population-weighted and assigned to the managing body's headquarters department, so values are departmental service approximations rather than exact territorial averages.

lenses.name: Microbial water compliance
lenses.description: Population-weighted SISPEA 2024 share of drinking-water controls compliant with mandatory microbiological limits. Multi-commune service territories are population-weighted and assigned to the managing body's headquarters department, so values are departmental service approximations rather than exact territorial averages.

lenses.name: Physicochemical water compliance
lenses.description: Population-weighted SISPEA 2024 share of drinking-water controls compliant with mandatory physicochemical limits such as pesticides, nitrates, chromium and bromate. Multi-commune service territories are population-weighted and assigned to the managing body's headquarters department, so values are departmental service approximations rather than exact territorial averages.

lenses.name: Water-network efficiency
lenses.unit: share of input water billed or used
lenses.description: Population-weighted SISPEA 2024 drinking-water distribution efficiency. Higher values mean less leakage relative to water entering the network. Multi-commune service territories are population-weighted and assigned to the managing body's headquarters department, so values are departmental service approximations rather than exact territorial averages.

lenses.name: Wastewater price
lenses.description: Population-weighted SISPEA 2024 collective-wastewater service price per cubic metre. Multi-commune service territories are population-weighted and assigned to the managing body's headquarters department, so values are departmental service approximations rather than exact territorial averages.

lenses.name: Sewer connection rate
lenses.description: Population-weighted SISPEA 2024 share of residents in collective-wastewater zones who are connectable and connected to the sewer network. Multi-commune service territories are population-weighted and assigned to the managing body's headquarters department, so values are departmental service approximations rather than exact territorial averages.

lenses.name: Wastewater treatment compliance
lenses.description: Population-weighted SISPEA 2024 compliant share of 24-hour treatment-performance balances for plants above 2,000 population-equivalent, weighted by incoming organic load. Multi-commune service territories are population-weighted and assigned to the managing body's headquarters department, so values are departmental service approximations rather than exact territorial averages.

lenses.name: Drinking-water limit compliance
lenses.description: Share of 2025 Hub'eau drinking-water samples compliant with mandatory bacteriological and physicochemical limits. Communes with fewer than three routine Escherichia coli control rows are treated as missing rather than assigning a noisy zero or perfect score. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice; this is a spatial approximation, not exact service locations.

lenses.name: Fully compliant water samples
lenses.description: Share of 2025 Hub'eau drinking-water samples whose whole multi-parameter regulatory conclusion was compliant with every measured requirement, including quality references as well as mandatory limits. Communes with fewer than three control rows are treated as missing. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice; this is a spatial approximation, not exact service locations.

lenses.name: Water-quality monitoring
lenses.description: Routine 2025 drinking-water control samples per 1,000 residents. This measures monitoring intensity, not water quality itself. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice; this is a spatial approximation, not exact service locations.

lenses.name: Recycling-centre access
lenses.description: Current ADEME SINOE recycling centres accepting household and similar waste per 100,000 residents. Counts are distributed approximately from commune polygons at a 1 km lattice. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice; this is a spatial approximation, not exact service locations.

lenses.name: Repair-service access
lenses.description: Distinct ADEME circular-economy actors offering repair services per 100,000 residents. The composite database includes contributed entries, so density is observed service availability rather than a complete business registry. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice; this is a spatial approximation, not exact service locations.

lenses.name: Reuse-infrastructure access
lenses.description: Distinct ADEME circular-economy actors classified as recycleries per 100,000 residents. Recycleries collect, repair, reuse and resell objects; the composite database is an observed-availability indicator rather than a statutory registry. Commune values are distributed approximately over commune polygons at a 1 km lattice; this is a spatial approximation, not exact service locations.
